name: Operation: Desert Road
author: Addicting Games
description: Operation Desert Road is a free tank game. We all love tanks. Tanks are one of the nation's favorite past times. Whether you are driving a tank, making a tank, buying a tank, or selling a tank. We can all agree that tanks are cool. Yay tanks. In this game, you will be in control of a tank, a really cool tank, and you will be driving it towards an unknown objective in the distance. On your way, there will be other tanks, guys running around, and armor stations that will try to stop you. Your job is to smash them, to blast them, or to ignore them and just drive by. To be clear you can actually just drive right past them. But it is more fun to blast and or smash so why not do the fun things, even if it takes longer. Stop and smell the roses, blow up some bad guys it is all the same because all things are equal when you're sitting behind the controls of a tank.
